MikroTik NVMe M.2 SSD 128GB UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License Level 6

The MikroTik NVMe M.2 SSD 128GB UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6 is a cutting-edge storage solution designed for high-performance MikroTik router setups. Featuring an NVMe M.2 PCIe solid-state drive, this product offers ultra-fast data access speeds and enhanced reliability, making it ideal for demanding network environments. The 128GB capacity provides ample storage for handling complex networking tasks, ensuring smooth operations even in larger, more resource-intensive deployments. This SSD is equipped with UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface) Boot, ensuring compatibility with modern hardware while delivering faster boot times and improved security compared to legacy BIOS systems. Pre-installed with RouterOS v7.17, the latest version of MikroTik’s renowned operating system, it comes ready to deploy for seamless network management. It also supports updates to the latest version, such as 7.17, ensuring your system can stay up-to-date with the newest features, improvements, and security patches. Included with the MikroTik NVMe M.2 SSD is the Level 6 RouterOS License, which grants access to advanced networking features, including high-level routing protocols, firewall configurations, and VPN management tools. This comprehensive license is perfect for building secure, scalable networks, offering maximum flexibility and control for both small businesses and large enterprises. The MikroTik NVMe M.2 SSD 128GB is built for use with MikroTik's PC-based machines as well as other supported server hardware. It combines top-tier performance with long-term durability, making it a reliable solution for anyone looking to optimize their MikroTik-powered network infrastructure. Additionally, the product comes with full technical support and a warranty, ensuring that users can deploy with confidence. Whether you’re upgrading your current system or starting a new deployment, this SSD is designed to meet the highest performance and reliability standards.

MikroTik NVMe M.2 SSD 128GB UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License Features

  • NVMe M.2 PCIe Solid State Drive
  • UEFI Boot
  • Build with PC Mikrotik Machine
  • Supported Server Mikrotik Machine
  • Capacity: 128GB
  • OS Version Update and Downgrade Support
  • OS Version v7.17 Pre-Install
  • Update Version 7.17 to Higher Version
  • Technical and Warranty Support
  • 1 Yar Warranty Support
